derivation: each value is a - b over fields of artifacts/pivot/deflate_topk.json; no model is re-run and no new measurement is made

selective_margin.meaning: accuracy on the model's own most-confident decile minus the best baseline's accuracy on its own most-confident decile, taking the maximum over ALL baselines

selective_margin_under_looser_frozen_set.meaning: NOT the reading used. Recorded so the declined concession is auditable: this is the margin the study would have claimed had 'best trivial baseline' been read as best-of-frozen-set instead of maximum-over-all-baselines.

top5_margin_expanded.meaning: top-5 accuracy minus the best baseline's top-5 over ALL baselines, deep trees included

top5_margin_frozen.meaning: top-5 accuracy minus the best PREREGISTERED baseline's top-5
